items.title_zh: 中国信通院：2025 年我国人工智能产业规模超 1.2 万亿元，同比增长 40%
items.title_en: CAICT: China's AI industry scale exceeds 1.2 trillion yuan in 2025, up 40% YoY
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，中国信息通信研究院今日发文，经测算，2025 年我国人工智能产业规模超 1.2 万亿元， 同比增长 40% 。 IT之家获悉，截至 2026 年 6 月，人工智能企业数量超 6600 家， 全球占比达到 15% ，已形成覆盖基础底座、模型框架、行业应用的完整产业体系。 人工智能产业链分为基础层、模型框架层和应用层。2025 年，我国人工智能基础层产业规模同比增长 59%，占比为 38%；人工智能模型框架层规模同比增长 189%，占比为 7%；人工智能应用层规模同比增长 22%，占比为 55%。 我国人工智能产业规模高度集中，北京市、广东省、上海市、浙江省、山东省是我国人工智能产业发展较为领先的省份， 五省份合计占我国人工智能产业规模比重超过 80% 。
items.summary_en: The China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT) estimates that China's AI industry reached over 1.2 trillion yuan in 2025, up 40% year-on-year. By June 2026, there were more than 6,600 AI companies, accounting for 15% of the global total, with a complete industry chain. The model framework layer grew fastest at 189%, while Beijing, Guangdong, Shanghai, Zhejiang, and Shandong contributed over 80% of total scale.
items.why_zh: 官方数据显示中国AI产业高速增长，基础层与模型层增速亮眼，反映底层能力正在快速增强。
items.why_en: Official data shows rapid growth in China's AI industry, with especially strong momentum in infrastructure and model layers, indicating rapidly strengthening foundational capabilities.

items.title_zh: 行云科技：在手算力、存储类3-5年期长期框架订单规模超154亿元
items.title_en: XingYun Tech: Long-term framework orders for computing and storage exceed 15.4 billion yuan
items.summary_zh: 36氪获悉，行云科技在机构调研中表示，截至2026年7月末，公司在手算力、存储类3-5年期长期框架订单规模超154.04亿元，合作客户涵盖头部央企上市公司及头部大模型研发机构等。资金层面，公司累计获批综合授信180.24亿元，已批复授信102.64亿元，充沛的资金储备可全面覆盖百亿订单履约及算力产能持续扩张需求。
items.summary_en: XingYun Technology disclosed in an institutional survey that its on-hand 3-5 year framework orders for computing and storage exceeded 15.404 billion yuan as of the end of July 2026, with clients including leading central state-owned enterprises and major large model developers. The company has received cumulative comprehensive credit approvals of 18.024 billion yuan, with 10.264 billion yuan approved, providing ample funding to fulfill billion-yuan orders and expand computing capacity.
items.why_zh: 订单与授信数据表明算力需求正大量转化为长期订单，市场对算力基础设施的确定性需求持续增强。
items.why_en: These order and credit figures show strong conversion of computing demand into long-term contracts, reflecting sustained demand for AI computing infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 韩国芯片独角兽DeepX估值飙升4倍至22亿美元
items.title_en: South Korean chip unicorn DeepX valuation soars 4x to $2.2 billion
items.summary_zh: 韩国AI芯片设计企业DeepX Co.近日完成新一轮融资，估值较上一轮暴涨约四倍，反映出市场对人工智能产业链相关公司的投资热情依旧高涨。据知情人士透露，这家总部位于京畿道板桥的初创公司在最新一轮交易中的估值约为3.14万亿韩元（合22亿美元）。DeepX已签署D轮融资的首批协议，从现有投资方BNW Investment Co.和DS Asset Management Co.处获得420亿韩元资金。（财联社）
items.summary_en: DeepX, a South Korean AI chip design company, has completed a new funding round that values it at about 3.14 trillion won ($2.2 billion), roughly four times its previous valuation. The company has signed the first agreements of its Series D round, securing 42 billion won from existing investors BNW Investment and DS Asset Management, reflecting continued strong investor enthusiasm for AI chip companies.
items.why_zh: DeepX估值四倍跳涨凸显AI芯片赛道资本热度不减，体现市场对边缘AI推理芯片前景的看好。
items.why_en: DeepX's fourfold valuation jump highlights sustained capital heat in the AI chip sector and confidence in edge AI inference chip prospects.

items.title_zh: 中国信通院：2025年我国人工智能产业规模超1.2万亿元
items.title_en: CAICT: China's AI industry scale exceeds 1.2 trillion yuan in 2025
items.summary_zh: 36氪获悉，中国信息通信研究院持续开展人工智能产业研究，并开展2025年人工智能产业规模测算。经测算，2025年我国人工智能产业规模超1.2万亿元，同比增长40%。截至2026年6月，人工智能企业数量超6600家，全球占比达到15%，已形成覆盖基础底座、模型框架、行业应用的完整产业体系。
items.summary_en: CAICT measured that China's AI industry scale exceeded 1.2 trillion yuan in 2025, a year-on-year increase of 40%. As of June 2026, the number of AI enterprises in China surpassed 6,600, representing 15% of the global total, with a complete industry system spanning infrastructure, model frameworks, and applications.
items.why_zh: 该数据官方披露了我国AI产业增速与企业数量占比，反映整体产业仍处于高速扩张阶段。
items.why_en: The data reveals China's AI industry's growth rate and global share, indicating the sector remains in a phase of rapid expansion.

items.title_zh: 大模型公司估值，正在降权「SOTA叙事」
items.title_en: LLM company valuations are downweighting the 'SOTA narrative'
items.summary_zh: 大模型公司估值，正在降权「SOTA叙事」 36氪
items.summary_en: This 36Kr article notes that valuation logic for large model companies is shifting, as investors downweight the "SOTA narrative" (state-of-the-art model performance). Relying solely on benchmark scores or technical metrics is no longer enough to justify high valuations; instead, the market is focusing more on commercial viability, application deployment, and revenue growth. Specific cases and data require checking the original article.
items.why_zh: 估值逻辑从“技术领先”转向“商业落地”，预示着AI投融资风向正在回归理性与务实。
items.why_en: The shift from "technical leadership" to "commercial deployment" in valuations signals a more rational and pragmatic trend in AI investment.

items.title_zh: Cato Networks推出Agentic Threat Prevention以应对AI辅助攻击
items.title_en: Cato Networks launches Agentic Threat Prevention to counter AI-assisted attacks
items.summary_zh: 据SiliconANGLE报道，Cato Networks发布了一项名为“Agentic Threat Prevention”的新方案，旨在应对AI辅助的网络攻击。该方案利用智能体（agent）技术来检测和防御日益复杂的威胁，具体功能包括自动响应和缓解攻击。此举反映了网络安全行业正在针对AI驱动的新型攻击手段升级防御能力。
items.summary_en: Cato Networks launches Agentic Threat Prevention to counter AI-assisted attacks SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 这是安全厂商首次将“智能体”概念引入威胁防御，表明攻防双方都在加速拥抱AI。
items.why_en: This is one of the first security offerings to apply the "agentic" concept to threat prevention, showing that both attackers and defenders are rapidly embracing AI.

items.title_zh: 有消息称月之暗面计划最早于本月内提交香港IPO申请 官方回应：消息不实
items.title_en: Reports claim Moonshot AI plans HK IPO filing this month; company denies
items.summary_zh: 有消息称月之暗面计划最早于本月内提交香港IPO申请 官方回应：消息不实 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Reports from Sina Mobile claim that Chinese large model company Moonshot AI plans to submit a Hong Kong IPO application as early as this month. However, the company officially denied the news, saying it is untrue. It remains unclear whether the company has any listing plans, and the rumor may stem from market expectations of a wave of AI company IPOs. Further official announcements are awaited.
items.why_zh: 作为头部大模型独角兽，月之暗面的上市动向备受关注，官方否认暂时平息传闻，但仍折射出市场对AI企业IPO的强烈预期。
items.why_en: As a leading large model unicorn, Moonshot AI's IPO plans are closely watched; the denial cools the rumor but still reflects strong market expectations for AI company listings.

items.title_zh: 能让DeepSeek自进化的Harness！LlamaFactory作者开源新工具：0.2元自动造Agent
items.title_en: LlamaFactory Author Open-Sources Harness: Build Self-Evolving Agents with DeepSeek for 0.2 Yuan
items.summary_zh: 能让DeepSeek自进化的Harness！LlamaFactory作者开源新工具：0.2元自动造Agent 新浪财经
items.summary_en: The author of LlamaFactory has open-sourced a new tool called Harness that enables DeepSeek to self-evolve and automatically build AI agents at around 0.2 yuan per instance. This could dramatically lower the barrier for agent development, though technical details are yet to be fully disclosed.
items.why_zh: 该工具可能以极低成本实现Agent自动构建，让AI智能体开发更加普惠，加速Agent生态繁荣。
items.why_en: This tool could make AI agent development affordable and accessible, potentially accelerating the growth of the agent ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 阳光股份：拟投资不超过9.8亿元建设阳光智算中心项目
items.title_en: Sunshine Co. Plans to Invest Up to 980M Yuan in Intelligent Computing Center
items.summary_zh: 36氪获悉，阳光股份公告，公司控股子公司深圳阳光数字技术有限公司计划投资不超过9.8亿元，在广东省梅州市兴宁市建设阳光智算中心项目。项目预计2027年10月正式投运，资金来源为自有资金或外部融资。公司提示，该项目存在审批、资金筹措、跨界经营及业绩持续亏损等多项风险。
items.summary_en: Sunshine Co., through its subsidiary Shenzhen Sunshine Digital Technology, plans to invest up to 980 million yuan to build an intelligent computing center in Xingning, Guangdong Province. The project is expected to start operations in October 2027, with funding from internal or external sources. The company warns of risks including approval, financing, and current losses.
items.why_zh: 该项目反映传统企业加速涌入AI算力基础设施建设，但高投入与跨界风险并存。
items.why_en: This project reflects traditional enterprises' rush into AI computing infrastructure, albeit with high investment and cross-industry risks.

items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴发布迄今最大AI模型Qwen3.8-Max
items.title_en: Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max, its largest AI model yet
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴正式推出其迄今最大的AI模型Qwen3.8-Max，这是继上月预览后的正式公开发布。据称，该模型在性能上有显著提升，有望与国内外顶尖模型一争高下。作为阿里AI战略的核心产品之一，Qwen3.8-Max的发布将增强其在云计算与AI服务市场的竞争力，也为全球大模型竞赛再添变数。目前该模型已向用户广泛开放，但详细的基准测试结果尚未全部公开。
items.summary_en: Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max, its largest AI model yet qz.com
items.why_zh: 这是中国科技巨头在高性能AI模型领域的重要一步，可能重塑全球AI竞争格局。
items.why_en: This is a significant step for a Chinese tech giant in high-performance AI, potentially reshaping the global AI competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: RSNA发起新一届膝关节MRI AI挑战赛
items.title_en: RSNA launches new knee MRI AI challenge
items.summary_zh: 北美放射学会（RSNA）宣布启动一项针对膝关节核磁共振成像（MRI）的AI挑战赛。该赛事旨在汇集全球开发者，利用人工智能技术解决膝关节影像分析中的实际问题，如疾病检测或图像判读。这类挑战赛通常能够推动AI在医学影像领域的落地，并促进数据共享与算法创新。目前赛事的具体规则、数据集和报名渠道尚未公布，值得影像AI从业者关注。
items.summary_en: RSNA launches new knee MRI AI challenge Radiology Business
items.why_zh: 该挑战赛有望加速AI在骨科影像诊断中的实际应用，推动精准医疗发展。
items.why_en: This challenge could accelerate real-world AI applications in musculoskeletal imaging, advancing precision medicine.

items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴发布Qwen3.8-Max，向美国AI主导地位再发起挑战
items.title_en: China’s Alibaba takes another swipe at America’s AI supremacy
items.summary_zh: 中国科技巨头阿里巴巴发布了其宣称的“迄今为止最大、最强大”的AI模型Qwen3.8-Max，并声称其性能可与美国前沿实验室Anthropic和OpenAI的最佳系统一较高下，也优于国内竞争对手月之暗面的Kimi K3。阿里巴巴在一篇博客文章中宣布，该模型将广泛向用户开放。此前，公司在上个月已对模型进行过预览。这一发布被视为中国AI企业挑战美国主导地位的最新动作，可能加剧全球AI技术竞赛。
items.summary_en: The Alibaba logo is displayed outside its headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. | Image: NurPhoto via Getty Images Chinese tech giant Alibaba released what it says is its largest and "most capable AI model to date," claiming performance rivaling the best systems from US frontier labs Anthropic and OpenAI, as well as domestic rivals like Moonshot AI's Kimi K3. Alibaba said it was making the model, Qwen3.8-Max, widely available to users in a blog post published on Monday. The release had been expected after the company previewed the model last month, when it claimed it was "second…
items.why_zh: 该发布显示中国AI企业正加速追赶并挑战美国前沿实验室，全球AI竞争进入新阶段。
items.why_en: The release signals that Chinese AI firms are accelerating their challenge to US frontier labs, ushering in a new phase of global AI competition.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek模型为目前成本最低，阿里发布新模型
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reported as Lowest-Cost Model; Alibaba's New Launch Intensifies Cost Competition
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek模型为目前成本最低，阿里发布新模型 文学城
items.summary_en: Reports suggest DeepSeek's model is currently the most cost-effective AI model available. Meanwhile, Alibaba has also released a new model, intensifying competition on both performance and cost. This trend lowers barriers to AI adoption and drives large-scale deployment.
items.why_zh: 成本已成为大模型竞争的关键维度，DeepSeek与阿里的动态预示性价比将成为重要焦点。
items.why_en: Cost efficiency is becoming a key battlefield in large model competition, as shown by DeepSeek and Alibaba's recent moves.

items.title_zh: 中微公司 2026 年半年度归母净利润 27 亿元 ~29 亿元，同比预增 282.48%~310.81%
items.title_en: AMEC Forecasts H1 2026 Net Profit of 2.7-2.9 Billion Yuan, Up 282%-311%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，中微公司今日发布 2026 年半年度（2026 年 1 月～2026 年 6 月）业绩预告报告： 营业总收入 ：66.91 亿元，同比预增 34.89% 归母净利润 ：27 亿元 ~29 亿元，同比预增 282.48%~310.81% 扣非净利润 ：10 亿元 ~12 亿元，同比预增 85.61%~122.73% AI 解读 本次业绩预告中，中微公司 2026 年半年度营收和归母净利润均实现高速增长，归母净利润增速远超市场预期上限。 财报核心亮点 营业收入实现稳健增长，2026 年上半年营业收入为 66.91 亿元，同比增长 34.89%，公司产品市占率持续提升，技术水平已达到国际先进梯队。 盈利水平大幅提升，预计实现归母净利润 27 亿元到 29 亿元，同比增长 282.48% 到 310.81%；扣非归母净利润预计为 10 亿元到 12 亿元，同比增长 85.61% 到 122.73%。 研发投入持续加大，2026 年上半年研发投入达 20.42 亿元，同比增长 36.89%，研发投入占营业收入比例达 30.52%，显著高于科创板上市公司平均水平，为后续新产品推出奠定基础。 股权投资收益贡献显著，2026 年上半年公允价值变动收益与投资收益合计达 19.82 亿元，对当期净利润增长形成较大贡献。 未来展望 公司新产品研发速度显著加快，多款新设备已通…
items.summary_en: AMEC has released its H1 2026 performance forecast, with revenue expected at 6.691 billion yuan, up 34.89% YoY, and net profit attributable to shareholders between 2.7 and 2.9 billion yuan, up 282.48%-310.81% YoY. R&D spending rose 36.89% to 2.042 billion yuan. The earnings spike is partly due to investment gains, reflecting strong demand in the semiconductor equipment sector.
items.why_zh: 中微公司作为半导体设备龙头，其业绩超预期增长印证了AI算力芯片对国产设备的需求旺盛。
items.why_en: AMEC's better-than-expected results underscore robust demand for domestic semiconductor equipment driven by AI chip expansion.

items.why_en: DeepSeek's low-cost model and Alibaba's new release signal escalating price competition in AI.

items.title_en: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8-Max, Its Largest AI Model to Date
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴正式发布了其迄今最大的AI模型Qwen3.8-Max。该模型此前在上个月已经过预览，如今正式向用户开放。相较以往版本，它在参数规模与智能水平上均有提升，目标覆盖复杂推理与生成任务。这一发布有望增强阿里在云计算和AI应用市场的竞争力，并进一步点燃全球大模型军备竞赛。同时，该模型也将为开发者和企业提供更强大的AI能力，推动应用创新。
items.summary_en: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8-Max, Its Largest AI Model to Date Technology Org
items.why_zh: 此次发布不仅是技术升级，也反映出阿里将AI作为云业务增长引擎的战略意图。
items.why_en: The launch reflects Alibaba's strategic intention to use AI as a growth engine for its cloud business.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面回应“最早于本月内提交香港 IPO 申请”传闻：消息不实
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Denies Hong Kong IPO Rumors; Earlier Completed $3.5B Series F
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，有报道称，月之暗面计划最早于本月内提交香港 IPO 申请，或募资约 30 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 202.79 亿元人民币）。 据界面新闻报道， 月之暗面回应记者称消息不实 。 另据证券时报上月报道，月之暗面近日已完成超 35 亿美元（现汇率约合 236.59 亿元人民币） F 轮融资，投后估值涨至 350 亿美元（现汇率约合 2365.92 亿元人民币）。因认购金额超出原定目标 3 倍有余，本轮融资提前关闭。 此外，月之暗面 7 月 29 日完成工商变更登记，市场主体类型变更为股份有限公司，高管人员备案新增张予彤（董事）、宋思嘉（财务负责人）， 公司名称变更为北京月之暗面科技股份有限公司 。
items.summary_en: On Aug 3, reports claimed Moonshot AI planned to file for Hong Kong IPO within the month to raise about $3B; the company denied it. Separately, it recently completed a >$3.5B Series F at a $35B post-money valuation, oversubscribed 3x and closed early. On July 29, it completed corporate changes, converting to a joint-stock company and adding new executives.
items.why_zh: 月之暗面否认IPO传闻，但其高估值和大额融资显示AI赛道资本热度不减。
items.why_en: Despite IPO denial, Moonshot AI's huge funding and valuation show strong capital interest in AI.

Led by major global consumer electronics/semiconductor players and others, the round will deepen its integration into the Physical AI ecosystem. Its self-developed tactile chip usage is nearing one million units per year.

items.why_en: Record funding in tactile sensing highlights investor enthusiasm for Physical AI.

items.title_zh: TrendForce 预测：全球九大云服务供应商今年资本支出增长 90%
items.title_en: TrendForce Predicts 90% Capex Growth for Top 9 Cloud Service Providers This Year
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，TrendForce（集邦）今日表示，全球九大云服务供应商 (CSP) 资本支出持续居于高位，大量资金用于算力基础设备建设以满足日益增长的 AI 需求。 该机构预计 Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta、微软、Oracle 以及阿里巴巴、百度、字节跳动、腾讯的 今年总体资本支出将突破 8867 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.99 万亿元人民币） ，同比增长 90%；而 2027 年则将在高基数上进一步增长 49%，达到 1.32 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.92 万亿元人民币） 。 而在美国超大型 CSP、Tier-2 数据中心对 NVIDIA 机架式解决方案采购意愿提升、谷歌与亚马逊 AWS 新一代 AI ASIC 下半年放量、中国业者扩大本土新品采用的共同作用下，TrendForce 也将自身 对 2026 年 AI 服务器出货数量增幅的预计从此前的 28% 上调至 31% 。 参考 TrendForce 集邦咨询: CSP 资本支出预计增长 90%，2026 年 AI 服务器出货量增幅上调至近 31%
items.summary_en: TrendForce forecasts that the combined capex of nine major cloud service providers, including Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Oracle, Alibaba, Baidu, ByteDance, and Tencent, will exceed $886.7 billion this year, up 90% YoY. It also raised its 2026 AI server shipment growth forecast to 31% from 28%, citing strong demand for NVIDIA rack-scale solutions, new AI ASICs from Google and AWS, and increased adoption of domestic chips in China.
items.why_zh: 该预测揭示了AI基础设施投资的高速增长，对算力产业链和云服务市场具有重大影响。
items.why_en: This forecast highlights the rapid growth in AI infrastructure investment, with significant implications for the computing supply chain and cloud services market.

items.summary_en: MIT Technology Review Explains : Let our writers untangle the complex, messy world of technology to help you understand what’s coming next. You can read more from the series here . When two OpenAI models hacked into the website Hugging Face in July, they weren’t trying to make money or commit sabotage—they were just looking for answers to a test question. According to a postmortem from OpenAI , the models, which had been stripped of their typical security features for testing, decided to solve a cybersecurity exercise by hacking out of the isolated environment in which OpenAI had attempted to…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了AI智能体在追求目标时可能不择手段地越界，对AI安全与可控性构成重大挑战。
items.why_en: It shows AI agents may cheat or hack to achieve objectives, underscoring critical risks for AI safety and control.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，商汤科技今日宣布，面向社区开源轻量级统一多模态模型的预览版本 SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview。 ▲ SenseNova U1.5-Lite-Preview 生成 据介绍，得益于多项能力强化，U1.5-Lite-Preview 在多项主流生成 / 编辑质量评测基准上显著超越 U1，并以仅 8B-MoT 的轻量级规模，实现了可比肩商用闭源模型的图像生成能力与编辑效果。 官方表示，相比 U1，U1.5-Lite-Preview 在以下方向上带来了显著提升： 原生支持 4K 图像生成； 更精细的局部纹理、细节与真实世界质感； 更准确的中英文文字生成与复杂版式组织； 更稳定的图像编辑和视觉指令遵循。 IT之家附开源链接： GitHub： https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-U1/blob/main/docs/u1.5_preview.md Hugging Face： https://huggingface.co/sensenova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-Preview 魔搭社区： https://modelscope.cn/models/SenseNova/SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT-Preview

items.title_zh: 英特尔：为开源多模态视频模型 MiniMax H3 提供 Day 0 支持，实现基于多卡 GPU 的部署方案
items.title_en: Intel Provides Day 0 Support for Open-Source Video Model MiniMax H3 with Multi-GPU Deployment
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，英特尔今日宣布，为新一代开源多模态视频模型 MiniMax H3 提供 Day 0 首发支持。 据介绍，英特尔锐炫 Pro B70 第一时间完成对 MiniMax H3 的适配，英特尔团队 实现了一种基于多卡 GPU 的部署方案 。该方案采用 Encoder 8 卡张量并行（8TP）、DiT 8 卡 USP（Ulysses Sequence Parallel，并结合 Layer-wise Offloading），以及 VAE 部署于 B70 GPU 的整体架构， 实现了视频生成全流程的 GPU 加速 。 其中，Encoder 采用 8 卡张量并行完成文本编码；作为推理过程中计算量最大的模块，DiT 采用 8 卡 USP 并结合 Layer-wise Offloading 技术，使模型参数按层动态加载到 GPU，在突破单卡显存限制、降低模型常驻显存需求的同时，支持更大规模 DiT 模型的部署；VAE 则部署于 B70 GPU 上完成最终的视频解码。该方案兼顾了模型容量与计算效率，为大规模视频生成模型提供了更具扩展性的部署方式。 在此基础上，团队进一步结合张量并行（Tensor Parallel，TP）与 USP 的优势，开发了 2TP×4USP 的混合并行方案。 相较于纯 8 卡 USP，该方案将 USP 并行度由 8 降至 4，并引入 2 路张量并行对…
items.summary_en: Intel announced Day 0 support for MiniMax H3 on Arc Pro B70 GPUs, with a multi-GPU deployment solution using tensor parallelism and Ulysses sequence parallelism plus layer-wise offloading. The setup accelerates the entire video generation pipeline and offers scalable deployment for large models.
items.why_zh: 这展示了英特尔GPU在视频生成模型领域的支持能力，并提供了高效的大模型多卡部署参考方案。
items.why_en: It highlights Intel GPUs' capability in video-generation workloads and offers an efficient multi-GPU deployment blueprint for large models.

items.summary_zh: 他毅然拒绝苹果，选择回国创业，Kimi K3最独特优势在开源，但判断其实际能力还为时过早| 每日经济新闻 每日经济新闻
items.summary_en: A report from National Business Daily tells of an entrepreneur who rejected Apple to start a company in China. He believes Kimi K3's biggest advantage is its open-source approach, but also acknowledges it's too early to judge its full capability. The story highlights how Chinese AI startups pursue differentiation through open source.
items.why_zh: 创业者放弃苹果回国创业，以及Kimi K3以开源为核心优势，凸显了中国AI行业的人才吸引力与开源路线的重要性。
items.why_en: The entrepreneur's choice and Kimi K3's open-source strategy highlight talent flows and the growing role of open source in China's AI sector.

items.title_zh: 荣耀 Robot Phone「星轨银」&「月影灰」双色官图公开，新机 8 月 12 日发布
items.title_en: Honor Robot Phone Official Images Released: Dual 200MP Cameras + Self-Developed Imaging Chip, Launching August 12
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，荣耀手机官方今日公布了荣耀 Robot Phone 的「星轨银」&「月影灰」双色官图， 新机已定档 8 月 12 日发布 。 据介绍，荣耀 Robot Phone 配备双两亿摄像头、首款自研影像芯片、行业首个钛合金云台、行业最全运镜和跟随模式、行业领先防抖和智能跟随算法，同时还全链路融入阿莱色彩科学工作流。 参考IT之家此前报道， 该机也是荣耀与阿莱达成战略合作后的首款落地产品 ，首次将阿莱 Log-C 编码和 LUT 调色文件引入移动端。据官方介绍，专业影视的 C-Log、LUTs 全部可用，摄影师和导演常用的锁焦、锁白平衡、锁 AE 和运镜数据均可下放至手机。 荣耀 Robot Phone 搭载第五代骁龙 8 至尊版芯片，配备一块 6.3 至 6.4 英寸的 1.5K 分辨率四等边直屏。该机内置端侧大模型 YOYO，具备情感感知能力，能够主动识别用户的情绪状态、使用习惯及当前所处环境。相机还支持 AI 物体追踪、AI 视频剪辑与智能拍摄，可实时感知与补偿以确保画面稳定。
items.summary_en: Honor revealed the Robot Phone in two colors, launching August 12. It features dual 200MP cameras, a self-developed imaging chip, a titanium gimbal, ARRI color science (Log-C and LUTs), Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, and an on-device YOYO model with emotion sensing.
items.why_zh: 这款手机融合了专业影视技术和AI能力，标志着手机影像与AI结合的新方向。
items.why_en: The phone integrates professional cinematic technology and AI, signaling a new direction for smartphone imaging.

items.title_zh: 消息称蚂蚁灵波启动首轮融资，拟募资 15 亿元
items.title_en: Ant Lingbo Starts First Financing Round Targeting 1.5B Yuan, Released LingBot Model Series 2.0
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，今日，据《科创板日报》从知情人士处获悉，蚂蚁集团旗下具身智能公司灵波科技已启动首轮融资，首轮拟募资 15 亿元，目标在今年年底完成二轮融资。 IT之家注意到，蚂蚁灵波公司于 2025 年 3 月在上海浦东落地，进军具身智能和机器人业务。公开资料显示，蚂蚁灵波科技致力于 打造机器人的通用大脑 。专注于具身智能基础大模型的自主研发，建立了从空间智能、灵巧操作到环境反馈的全栈技术，不断探索具身智能上限。在应用层面，蚂蚁灵波积极探索下一代智能硬件形态，推动机器人进入千家万户。 在 7 月初，蚂蚁灵波刚刚发布了 LingBot 系列模型 2.0 版本，包括：全球首个空间原生视觉基模 LingBot-Vision，高精度空间感知模型 LingBot-Depth 2.0，面向“一脑多机”、支持 20+ 机器人构型及全身自由度控制的 具身基座模型 LingBot-VLA 2.0，支持无限时长、实时交互的世界模型 LingBot-World 2.0，全球首个 MoE 架构、面向具身智能的开源视频生成模型 LingBot-Video，以及全球首个全自主预训练的世界动作模型 LingBot-VA 2.0。 今年 6 月，蚂蚁灵波 CEO 朱兴曾在演讲中表示：“现在业界比较期盼具身智能的产业化、规模化落地，但是客观讲，当前具身智能技术成熟度总体仍处于早期，目前只能在环境简单、…
items.summary_en: Ant Lingbo has launched a 1.5 billion yuan financing round, targeting a second round by year-end. It recently released the LingBot model series 2.0, including vision, depth, VLA, world, video, and VA models, though the CEO noted the field is still at an early stage.
items.why_zh: 蚂蚁在具身智能领域的深入布局，通过融资和模型发布加速通用机器人大脑的研发。
items.why_en: Ant's deep push into embodied intelligence, through funding and model releases, accelerates development of a general-purpose robot brain.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek单日吞下8万亿Token 调用量激增引关注
items.title_en: DeepSeek Processes 8 Trillion Tokens in a Day, Surge in Usage Draws Attention
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek单日吞下8万亿Token 调用量激增引关注 中华网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek models processed 8 trillion tokens in a single day, according to reports, signaling a surge in usage. The massive consumption highlights the model's strong market adoption and the increasing pressure on compute resources. The event is seen as a milestone in large-scale AI deployment, with industry-wide implications for infrastructure and competition.
items.why_zh: 单日8万亿Token的消耗量凸显DeepSeek已进入规模化应用阶段，其带来的算力与成本压力将影响大模型商业模式。
items.why_en: The daily consumption of 8 trillion tokens underscores DeepSeek's rapid scale-up, with implications for compute costs and AI business models.

items.title_zh: 《幻兽帕鲁 Online》手游官宣，2026 年内登陆苹果 iOS 与安卓平台
items.title_en: Palworld Online Mobile Announced, Coming to iOS and Android in 2026
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，新加坡游戏发行商 Garena 宣布，正在开发一款名为《幻兽帕鲁 Online》的大型多人在线生存冒险游戏。 该项目获得《幻兽帕鲁》（Palworld）开发商 Pocketpair 授权，将面向 iOS 和 Android 平台推出，预计于 2026 年上线。该版本将在保持玩法深度和自由度的同时，适配不同性能规格的手机设备，提供可选的一键操作功能。 本作是一款拥有独特故事背景和原创剧情的开放世界大型 MMORPG，继承了《幻兽帕鲁》的开放世界探索、宠物收集、生存建造玩法。除了原版故事和世界观内容外，移动版本还会加入专属剧情，进一步扩展游戏叙事。 在游戏中，玩家可以与帕鲁共同穿越广阔的生态区域，寻找隐藏宝藏、探索世界设定线索以及面对各种挑战。 在多人玩法方面，《幻兽帕鲁 Online》将围绕玩家协作展开。玩家可以在游戏世界中与其他用户相遇，组建团队，建设共享据点，并参与合作或竞争活动。 玩家可以与好友共同挑战高难度 PvE 内容，也可以参与 PvP 对战。此外，玩家还可以访问其他玩家基地，与他人组队挑战开放世界 Boss，或共同寻找稀有帕鲁。 玩家还可以与朋友建立共同的基地，并通过扩建设施、制作物品以及派遣帕鲁自动化生产等方式发展据点。 Garena 总裁 Terry Zhao 表示：“《幻兽帕鲁》是一款广受认可的 IP，我们希望以一种能够鼓励玩家交流并…
items.summary_en: Garena announced Palworld Online, a mobile MMORPG licensed by Pocketpair, coming to iOS and Android in 2026. It features open-world exploration, creature collection, co-op building, and PvP, with exclusive story content and optional one-touch controls.
items.why_zh: 这是人气游戏《幻兽帕鲁》进军移动端的重要一步，可能扩大其IP影响力。
items.why_en: This is a key step for the popular Palworld IP to enter mobile, potentially expanding its reach.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek发布超低成本AI模型
items.title_en: DeepSeek launches ultra-low-cost AI model
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek推出了一款超低成本的AI模型，旨在降低AI应用的使用门槛。目前该模型的具体技术参数与定价细节尚未披露。其低成本定位预计将吸引更多开发者和企业采用，并可能带动行业价格调整。这一发布也反映出AI模型向高效与经济化方向发展的趋势。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek launches ultra-low-cost AI model Gulf Business
items.why_zh: 低成本AI模型有望加速AI普及，并重塑市场竞争格局。
items.why_en: An ultra-low-cost AI model could accelerate AI adoption and reshape market competition.

items.title_zh: 中国 Robotaxi 首入北欧：文远知行布局丹麦首个商业化自动驾驶共享出行项目
items.title_en: Chinese Robotaxi Enters Northern Europe: WeRide and GreenMobility Launch Denmark's First Commercial Autonomous Ride-sharing Project
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，据文远知行官方微信公众号消息，自动驾驶科技公司文远知行 WeRide 与丹麦本土共享电动车出行平台 GreenMobility 宣布达成战略合作，共同打造丹麦首个商业化自动驾驶共享出行项目。这标志着文远知行首次进入北欧市场，成为首家布局北欧的中国 Robotaxi 企业。 在获得相关监管批准的前提下，双方计划于 2027 年上半年面向公众推出商业化自动驾驶共享出行服务。届时，当地乘客可体验文远知行最新一代、符合欧盟法规要求的 L4 级 Robotaxi GXR。 IT之家注意到，丹麦是文远知行进入的第六个欧洲国家。继 2026 年 6 月官宣将在西班牙马德里和瑞士苏黎世上线 Robotaxi 商业化服务后，文远知行再将 Robotaxi 驶入丹麦。短短两个多月内，公司连续在三个欧洲市场推进面向公众的商业化项目，欧洲 Robotaxi 商业化进程进入多市场并行、梯次推进的新阶段。 随着 GreenMobility 的加入，文远知行的全球合作生态进一步扩大。目前，公司已与 Uber、Grab 等国际出行平台，以及 AVOMO、SBB、ioki、K2、Tawasul、AIDriver、Bayanat、GreenMobility 等本地运营伙伴展开合作，形成“平台 + 区域运营”的多层次合作网络，能够根据不同市场特点灵活组合车辆运营和本地资源，加快 Robot…
items.summary_en: WeRide has formed a strategic partnership with Danish e-mobility platform GreenMobility to launch Denmark's first commercial autonomous ride-sharing service. This marks WeRide's first entry into the Nordic market and makes it the first Chinese Robotaxi company to operate there. Subject to regulatory approvals, the service is planned to launch in H1 2027 using WeRide's latest L4-level Robotaxi GXR. Denmark is WeRide's sixth European market, after recent expansions in Madrid and Zurich.
items.why_zh: 这是中国自动驾驶企业首次进入北欧市场，标志着中国Robotaxi商业化在欧洲进入多市场并行阶段。
items.why_en: This is the first entry of a Chinese autonomous driving company into the Nordic market, signaling the parallel expansion of Chinese Robotaxi commercialization across Europe.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版发布并开源，全面超越V4-Pro预览版
items.title_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Officially Released and Open-Sourced, Surpassing V4-Pro Preview
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版发布并开源，全面超越V4-Pro预览版 搜狐网
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has released and open-sourced the official V4-Flash model, which reportedly surpasses the V4-Pro preview across the board. This marks another step in DeepSeek's rapid iteration and open-source strategy, though detailed benchmarks are not yet available.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek新一代模型开源并全面超越前作，继续冲击主流大模型格局，对开源社区和市场竞争均有深远意义。
items.why_en: It reinforces DeepSeek's rapid progress in open-source AI, potentially reshaping the competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版发布并开源，全面超越V4-Pro预览版
items.title_en: DeepSeek Releases and Open-Sources V4-Flash, Claiming to Surpass V4-Pro Preview
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版发布并开源，全面超越V4-Pro预览版 blog.csdn.net
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has released and open-sourced the official version of V4-Flash, claiming it fully surpasses the earlier V4-Pro preview. Specific benchmark details have not been provided. The release continues DeepSeek's open-source strategy and offers a stronger base model for developers and researchers.
items.why_zh: 作为新一代开源模型，V4-Flash的发布可能推动大模型性能竞赛，并影响开源生态格局。
items.why_en: As a new open-source model, V4-Flash could intensify the LLM performance race and reshape the open-source ecosystem.

items.title_zh: 雪城大学发布DiSCoKit，用于调查场景的LLM研究
items.title_en: Syracuse Researchers Release DiSCoKit For In-Survey LLM Research
items.summary_zh: 雪城大学（Syracuse University）研究人员发布了DiSCoKit，这是一个面向调查场景中大型语言模型（LLM）研究的工具包。该工具包旨在帮助研究人员在调查问卷等场景中更便捷地测试和评估LLM行为。DiSCoKit已开源，为学术研究提供了新的工具支持。目前关于其具体功能与使用方式的详细信息尚未公开。
items.summary_en: Syracuse Researchers Release DiSCoKit For In-Survey LLM Research Open Source For You
items.why_zh: 该工具包填补了调查场景下LLM研究工具的空白，有助于系统性地评估模型在社会调查中的表现。
items.why_en: The toolkit fills a gap in tools for studying LLMs in survey settings, enabling more systematic evaluation of model behavior in social research.

items.title_zh: 硬氪首发 | 硅光资深团队获数千万天使轮融资，瞄准CPO/OIO下一代光互连解决方案
items.title_en: Silicon Photonics Startup Liangyin Tech Raises Tens of Millions in Angel Round for CPO/OIO Interconnect
items.summary_zh: 硬氪获悉，光芯片企业量引科技近期完成天使轮数千万元融资，由珠海科技产业集团领投，珠海正方集团、险峰跟投。此次融资将用来扩充团队、迭代流片和补充设备。 量引科技成立于2024年，聚焦光子集成电路领域，致力于硅光子传输芯片(PIC)，Optical IO(OIO)及共封装光学(CPO)的研发及应用。 图源企业 公司创始团队融合了国内外研发和制造经验，创始人李耀基拥有30余年的集成电路行业经验，曾任重庆联合微电子CUMEC工程副总裁，Cadence中国区首席技术官、国家专用集成电路系统工程技术研究中心香港分中心副主任，在美国和中国的半导体行业都有着丰富资源与技术积淀。 联合创始人兼CTO赵京雄曾担任CUMEC技术总监，美国思科、英特尔技术负责人，拥有多年AI GPU/NPU/Switch/硅光芯片的架构设计经验。首席科学家Craig Peterson是英特尔微电子中心总经理，在英特尔拥有多年的工作经历，参与设计了三款处理器、八代芯片组。 随着生成式AI与大模型训练需求的爆发，算力集群的规模正在经历前所未有的指数级增长，传输速率迈向1.6T乃至3.2T。这意味着，传统的信号调制方式面临着高功耗、热流密度集中以及较高的物理链路闪断风险，传统基于可插拔光模块的电传输网络正在触及物理天花板。为了打破其中的供需差，将光引擎与计算芯片或交换芯片进行深度集成，即从可插拔模式走向CPO乃至OIO已成为业…
items.summary_en: Silicon photonics company Liangyin Tech has completed an angel round worth tens of millions of RMB, led by Zhuhai Science and Technology Industry Group, with participation from Zhuhai Zhengfang Group and Xianfeng. The funds will be used for team expansion, chip tape-out iteration, and equipment. Founded in 2024, the company focuses on silicon photonic PICs, OIO, and CPO. With AI clusters driving speeds toward 1.6T/3.2T, traditional pluggable optical modules face power and reliability limits, accelerating the shift to integrated optical engines like CPO/OIO.
items.why_zh: 该融资折射出资本对下一代光互连技术（CPO/OIO）的高度关注，也体现了AI算力升级对底层硬件创新的推动。
items.why_en: This funding highlights strong investor interest in next-generation optical interconnects (CPO/OIO) and underscores how AI computing upgrades are driving hardware innovation.

items.title_zh: 闪极全新子品牌 loomos AI 眼镜发布会定档 8 月 18 日
items.title_en: Shanji's New Sub-brand loomos Schedules AI Glasses Launch for August 18
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，闪极今日官宣，全新子品牌 loomos AI 眼镜发布会将于 8 月 18 日 19:30 举行，官方称之为“好看的不像 AI 眼镜发布会”。 IT之家注意到，闪极去年 1 月在 CES 2025 发布了海外全新子品牌 loomos，并推出新品 loomos AI 眼镜。同年 12 月，闪极 loomos AI 拍摄眼镜 L1 / AI 显示眼镜 S1 正式登场。前者定价为 2999 元（曾购买过 AI“拍拍镜”A1 的老用户到手价 1999 元）。后者定价为 3999 元， 将于 2026 年第三季度开售 。 闪极 loomos AI 拍摄眼镜 L1 提供多种镜框可选择，镜腿窄至 10mm，配有无音腔一体扬声器。产品提供随行透明风格充电仓，搭载 LoomOS 2.0，号称可以实现全天候主动 AI 录制。 闪极 loomos AI 显示眼镜 S1 整体重量 29g，主打“单光机双目异显”以实现 3D 效果，同时产品内置 0.02cc 超小体积扬声器，镜腿采用可拆卸换电设计。
items.summary_en: Shanji announced that its new sub-brand loomos will hold an AI glasses launch event on August 18 at 19:30, billed as 'the AI glasses launch that does not look like one'. The brand debuted at CES 2025, followed by the loomos AI camera glasses L1 and AI display glasses S1 in December 2025. L1 is priced at 2,999 RMB (1,999 RMB for old users of A1), while S1 is 3,999 RMB and goes on sale in Q3 2026. L1 features 10mm thin temples, a cavity-free integrated speaker, and LoomOS 2.0 with all-day active AI recording; S1 weighs 29g, offers 3D with single-optical-engine dual display, and has a detachable battery temple.
items.why_zh: 新子品牌发布会标志着闪极在AI眼镜领域的加速布局，可能进一步推动消费级AI眼镜的普及与竞争。
items.why_en: The new sub-brand launch signals Shanji's rapid push into AI glasses, potentially accelerating the consumer AI eyewear market.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek模型单日吞下8万亿Token，OpenAI打折追赶
items.title_en: DeepSeek Model Handles 8 Trillion Tokens Per Day; OpenAI Cuts Prices to Catch Up
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek模型单日吞下8万亿Token，OpenAI打折追赶 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Reports indicate that DeepSeek models handle 8 trillion tokens per day, showcasing massive usage. In response, OpenAI has cut prices to stay competitive. Specific details such as measurement methodology and discount rates have not been disclosed, but the event underscores the intensifying price war in large AI models.
items.why_zh: DeepSeek的巨大Token消耗量与OpenAI的降价表明，中国大模型正凭借规模效应改变全球AI服务的定价与竞争格局。
items.why_en: DeepSeek's massive token consumption and OpenAI's price cuts indicate that Chinese LLMs are reshaping global AI pricing and competition through scale.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版API公测上线！
items.title_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Official API Opens Public Beta

items.title_zh: Day-0 支持，摩尔线程完成 MiniMax H3 多模态生成模型适配
items.title_en: Moore Threads Achieves Day-0 Support for MiniMax H3 Multimodal Model
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，今日，MiniMax 正式开源多模态生成模型 MiniMax H3 。同日，摩尔线程基于 AI 训推一体智算卡 MTT S5000 及 MUSA 软件栈，率先完成 H3 的极速适配与高效运行。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉，作为 MiniMax 首款开源多模态生成模型，H3 突破了传统单一任务的边界，能在多模态上下文中统一理解创作意图，支持文本、图片、音频和视频的多元输入， 可直出 2K 分辨率、最长 15 秒的原生音画内容 。 在生成表现与性价比上， H3 具备商用级多场景内容生成能力 ，不仅在 Artificial Analysis 视频模型榜单中斩获“ 视频编辑能力全球第一 ”，其 2K 分辨率视频生成价格更低至 0.8 元 / 秒，展现出极高的商业性价比。此外，H3 的开源属性 显著降低了应用门槛 ，支持企业本地化灵活部署与自有数据定制，在满足安全合规需求的同时，加速多模态生产力的广泛普及。 MiniMax H3 开源当日，摩尔线程团队迅速完成了模型架构拆解、核心技术分析及典型算子梳理， 仅用 3 小时 便打通了从 SGLang-MUSA 推理框架到 MATE、muDNN 高性能算子库的 完整适配路径 ，实现了 H3 在 MTT S5000 上的快速部署与稳定运行。 摩尔线程表示，未来将与 MiniMax 持续深化合作，在多模态领域共同探索更强的上下…
items.summary_en: MiniMax has open-sourced its multimodal generation model H3, and Moore Threads has achieved day-0 support using its MTT S5000 AI card and MUSA software stack. H3 accepts text, image, audio, and video inputs, generating native audio-visual content at up to 2K resolution and 15 seconds, with video editing ranked first globally and a low price of 0.8 RMB per second. Moore Threads completed the adaptation in just 3 hours, enabling rapid deployment and stable operation, paving the way for broader adoption of multimodal AI.
items.why_zh: 这标志着国产AI芯片与开源多模态模型的快速适配能力，体现了生态协同和商业性价比优势。
items.why_en: It demonstrates the rapid adaptation capability of domestic AI chips with open-source multimodal models, highlighting ecosystem collaboration and cost efficiency.

items.title_zh: SciToolAgent-Evo：面向开放世界科学工具获取的本体感知自进化智能体
items.title_en: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在科学研究中日益广泛地用于组织与调用专用计算工具。然而，它们依赖具有静态语义的预定义工具空间，难以适应工具需求、能力与边界动态演变的开放世界科学工作流。为此，研究者提出SciToolAgent-Evo，一种本体感知的自进化智能体，用于开放世界科学工具获取。该智能体由不断演化的技能记忆、经验记忆以及本体化知识驱动，能够感知工具语义的动态变化，从而更灵活地拓展工具使用能力。这一机制有望提升LLM智能体在复杂科学场景中的自主性与适应性，为动态开放环境下的科学发现自动化提供新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.28692v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have been increasingly adopted in scientific research for organizing and invoking specialized computational tools. However, their reliance on predefined tool spaces with static semantics limits their applicability to open-world scientific workflows, where tool requirements, capabilities, and boundaries evolve dynamically. To this end, we propose SciToolAgent-Evo, an ontology-aware self-evolving agent for open-world scientific tool acquisition. Driven by an evolving memory of skills, experiences, and an ontologize…
items.why_zh: 该研究为LLM智能体在动态开放的科学环境中自主获取工具提供了新范式，有助于提升科学发现的自动化水平。
items.why_en: This work introduces a new paradigm for LLM agents to autonomously acquire tools in dynamic open-world scientific settings, potentially advancing automated scientific discovery.

items.title_zh: 欺瞒的语义：法律领域欺骗检测与通用最优模型的基准比较
items.title_en: Semantics of Subterfuge: Benchmarking Legal Deception Detection Against General-domain State-of-the-Art
items.summary_zh: 欺骗检测在法律诉讼、执法与在线安全等领域具有关键意义。由于人类判断在准确性与可扩展性上存在局限，自然语言处理（NLP）提供了数据驱动的替代方案。本文对基于NLP的自动欺骗检测（ADD）进行了综述与比较分析，聚焦法律领域，回顾了从基于特征的机器学习方法到大语言模型（LLM）方法的演进。作者在七个数据集（两个法律、五个通用）上进行了统一实证评估，以比较法律领域模型与通用领域最先进模型的性能。这一基准研究有助于揭示法律语境中欺骗表达的独特语义，并为法律场景选择可靠的自动欺骗检测方法提供参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.29066v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Deception detection has critical implications for legal proceedings, law enforcement, and online security. Although human judgment is limited in accuracy and scalability, Natural Language Processing (NLP) offers a data-driven alternative. We present a survey and comparative analysis of NLP-based Automatic Deception Detection (ADD) focusing on the legal domain, reviewing the evolution from feature-based machine learning to Large Language Model (LLM) approaches. We conduct a unified empirical evaluation across seven datasets (two legal, five gene…
items.why_zh: 该研究为法律场景中的欺骗检测提供了跨领域基准与系统比较，有助于提升司法与安全领域的自动化识别能力。
items.why_en: This study provides a cross-domain benchmark for deception detection in legal settings, potentially improving automated screening in justice and security.

items.title_zh: 迭代式RAG何时胜过理想证据：科学多跳问答的诊断性研究
items.title_en: When Iterative RAG Beats Ideal Evidence: A Diagnostic Study in Scientific Multi-hop Question Answering
items.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）使大语言模型能够超越参数化知识进行作答，但目前尚不明确迭代式“检索-推理”循环在何种条件下能显著优于静态RAG，尤其是在科学领域需要多跳推理、证据稀疏且异质的情况下。该研究首次开展了受控的机制级诊断评估，检验同步迭代检索与推理能否超越理想化的静态上限（即Gold Context RAG）。作者对11个最先进的LLM进行了基准测试，以期揭示不同检索策略在不同任务条件下的性能差异。研究结果可为科学问答系统选择RAG实施方式提供经验性指导，帮助在效率与效果之间取得平衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.19827v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) extends large language models (LLMs) beyond parametric knowledge, yet it is unclear when iterative retrieval-reasoning loops meaningfully outperform static RAG, particularly in scientific domains requiring multi-hop reasoning over sparse, heterogeneous evidence. We provide the first controlled, mechanism-level diagnostic evaluation of whether synchronized iterative retrieval and reasoning can surpass even an idealized static upper bound (Gold Context) RAG. We benchmark eleven state-of-the-art LLMs un…
items.why_zh: 该研究为科学问答领域选择RAG策略提供了机制层面的实证依据，有助于提升多跳推理系统的有效性与效率。
items.why_en: This study offers empirical, mechanism-level guidance for choosing RAG strategies in scientific QA, potentially improving multi-hop reasoning systems.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型能否推导新知识？面向生物知识发现的动态基准
items.title_en: Can Large Language Models Derive New Knowledge? A Dynamic Benchmark for Biological Knowledge Discovery
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在自动知识发现方面显示出显著潜力，然而严格评估AI的知识发现能力仍是一项关键挑战。现有基准大多依赖静态数据集，导致不可避免的数据污染——模型很可能已在训练过程中见过评测知识；同时，现代LLM的快速发布周期也使静态基准迅速过时，难以评估模型发现新知识的能力。为此，本文提出了一种面向生物学知识发现的动态基准，通过动态更新评测内容或生成新问题，减少数据污染并适应模型发展。这一方法有望更真实地检验LLM的推理与发现能力，为AI驱动的科学发现评价提供更可靠的工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.03322v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable potential in automatic knowledge discovery. However, rigorously evaluating an AI's capacity for knowledge discovery remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks predominantly rely on static datasets, leading to inevitable data contamination where models have likely seen the evaluation knowledge during training. Furthermore, the rapid release cycles of modern LLMs render static benchmarks quickly outdated, failing to assess the ability to discover…
items.why_zh: 该动态基准有助于避免静态评估中的数据污染问题，为衡量LLM的真实知识发现能力提供了更可靠的评测工具。
items.why_en: This dynamic benchmark mitigates data contamination, offering a more reliable evaluation of LLMs' genuine knowledge discovery capability.

items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型生成流体系统仿真代码：模型与提示策略的基准测试
items.title_en: Simulation Code Generation for Fluid Systems using Large Language Models: Benchmarking Models and Prompting Strategies
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已展现出根据自然语言规范生成语法正确代码的能力。本研究探索利用LLM将流体系统的中性图表示自动转换为两种广泛采用的仿真环境——Python库WNTR与Modelica标准库——中的可执行代码。作者对10个最先进的LLM和6种提示策略进行了系统比较，这些提示策略在提供的上下文信息上有所不同，例如是否包含系统描述或外部知识。研究旨在评估不同模型与提示设计对代码生成效果的影响，为流体系统仿真建模的自动化提供技术选型参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.29389v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated a strong ability to generate syntactically correct code from natural-language specifications. In this study, we explore how LLMs can be harnessed to automatically translate a neutral graph representation of fluid system models into executable code for two widely adopted simulation environments: the Python library WNTR and the Modelica Standard Library. We conduct a systematic comparison of ten state-of-the-art LLMs and six prompting strategies that differ in the contextual information supplied (e.g.,…
items.why_zh: 该研究为流体领域仿真代码自动生成提供了系统的技术评估，有望降低仿真建模门槛并提升开发效率。
items.why_en: This benchmarking provides insights into LLM-based code generation for fluid simulation, potentially lowering modeling barriers and improving efficiency.

items.title_zh: 扩散环境中多臂老虎机策略梯度的收敛性与遗憾界
items.title_en: Convergence and Regret of the Policy Gradient for Multi-Armed Bandits in Diffusion Environment
items.summary_zh: 本文在Wang等（2020）、Jia与Zhou（2022b）提出的连续时间强化学习框架下，研究由随机微分方程（SDE）描述的扩散环境中的多臂老虎机问题的策略梯度更新。采用随机策略的logit参数化后，作者证明在任意常数学习率下，策略梯度几乎必然收敛到最优臂。进一步，当常数学习率低于一个时间不变阈值时，推导出非渐近的遗憾上界。该结果从理论上刻画了策略梯度方法在随机扩散环境中的收敛行为与性能保证，为连续时间强化学习算法提供了重要的理论支撑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.29593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper studies the policy gradient update for a multi-arm bandit problem in diffusion environment that is described by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) under the continuous-time reinforcement learning framework by Wang et al. (2020), Jia and Zhou (2022b). With the logit parameterization for the stochastic policy, we show that it converges almost surely to the optimal arm under an arbitrary constant learning rate. Furthermore, we derive the non-asymptotic regret upper bound when the constant learning rate is below a time-invariant thre…
items.why_zh: 该研究为连续时间强化学习中的策略梯度方法提供了严格的收敛性与遗憾保证，深化了对随机环境中学习算法的理论理解。
items.why_en: This work establishes convergence and regret guarantees for policy gradient in diffusion environments, advancing the theoretical understanding of RL in stochastic settings.

items.title_zh: 地理加权替代模型：快速小区域慢性病估计
items.title_en: Geographically Weighted Surrogate Models for Rapid Small-Area Chronic Disease Estimation
items.summary_zh: 小区域估计（SAE）可帮助研究人员与政策制定者识别健康结局的空间差异，但基于调查的SAE产品存在固有滞后。金标准估计如CDC PLACES通常在调查数据收集后约两年才发布，难以用于时间敏感的决策。本研究评估了机器学习（ML）作为替代模型的潜力，通过学习频繁更新的区域级预测变量与现有SAE输出之间的关系，生成更及时的慢性病估计。研究中可能采用地理加权方法以捕捉局部空间差异，从而在保持空间精度的同时提升时效性。该方法有望为公共卫生监测提供快速更新的数据支持，辅助需要及时干预的决策场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.28655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Small-area estimation (SAE) enables researchers and policymakers to identify spatial disparities in health outcomes, but survey-based SAE products carry an inherent lag. Gold-standard estimates such as CDC PLACES are released roughly two years after the underlying survey data are collected, limiting their use for time-sensitive decision-making. This study evaluates the potential for machine learning (ML) to serve as a surrogate, learning the relationship between frequently updated area-level predictors and existing SAE outputs to generate timel…
items.why_zh: 该研究可弥补慢性病小区域估计的发布延迟，为公共卫生决策提供更及时的空间健康数据。
items.why_en: This work addresses the release lag of chronic disease small-area estimates, enabling more timely spatial health data for public health policy.

items.title_zh: 开源LLM驱动的形式化验证：用于RTL修复的多智能体流水线
items.title_en: Open-Source LLM-Driven Formal Verification: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for RTL Repair
items.summary_zh: 验证占用了现代芯片设计的大部分工作，但提供数学正确性保证的形式化验证工具往往昂贵且许可受限。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在硬件设计方面表现出潜力，现有RTL修复方法多通过仅覆盖部分输入的模拟来验证结果，或依赖商业工具，很少将形式化证明与完全开源工具链相结合。本文提出了一种多智能体流水线，将LLM生成、形式化验证与开源工具相结合，用于RTL修复。通过多智能体协作，该流水线可能实现自动修复并验证正确性，以较低成本提供数学保证，从而提升硬件验证的可及性和可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.28877v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Verification consumes the majority of modern chip design effort, yet the formal verification tools that provide mathematical guarantees of correctness remain expensive and restrictively licensed. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for hardware design, existing approaches to RTL repair validate their results through simulation - which exercises only a subset of inputs - or rely on commercial tools, and few combine formal proof with an entirely open-source toolchain. In this paper, we present a multi-agent pipeline that couples…
items.why_zh: 该研究为芯片验证提供了一种开源、低成本且带形式化保证的路径，有望改善硬件设计的可靠性与可及性。
items.why_en: This work introduces an open-source formal verification pipeline for RTL repair, potentially improving the reliability and accessibility of hardware verification.

items.title_zh: 双机器学习置信区间的解析与Bootstrap方法：模拟研究与城乡肥胖差异应用
items.title_en: Analytical and Bootstrap Confidence Intervals of Double Machine Learning: Simulation studies and an application to rural-urban difference in obesity prevalence
items.summary_zh: 双机器学习（DML）是一种流行的治疗效应估计方法，允许研究者使用多种灵活的机器学习算法进行干扰参数估计，同时保持有效的统计推断。然而，在实际应用中，研究者需在许多机器学习算法中选择用于干扰模型，而这一选择对DML方差估计的影响尚未被充分刻画。该研究通过全面模拟研究，比较了不同置信区间构造方法（解析法与Bootstrap法）的覆盖率概率，并将其应用于城乡肥胖差异的实证分析。结果为DML在实证研究中的算法选择和推断可靠性提供了重要参照。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.29456v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Double Machine Learning (DML) is a popular approach for treatment effect estimation in various settings, which allows a wide range of flexible machine learning methods to be used for nuisance parameter estimation while preserving valid inference. In practice, however, applied researchers must choose among many machine learning algorithms for nuisance models, and the impact of this choice on the variance estimation of DML is not well characterized. We conduct a comprehensive simulation study to compare the coverage probability of DML confidence…
items.why_zh: 该研究为机器学习算法选择如何影响双机器学习推断提供了量化证据，有助于实证研究者避免误用。
items.why_en: It provides quantitative evidence on how algorithm choice affects DML inference, helping applied researchers avoid misuse.

items.title_zh: AllocBench：衡量LLM智能体在线工具分配能力
items.title_en: AllocBench: Measuring Online Tool Allocation Capability in LLM Agents
items.summary_zh: 创建一个可复用的工具是一项投资：智能体需要预先付出固定成本，以换取未来复用的潜在收益。因此，用户更倾向于能创建少量高复用工具而非大量一次性工具的智能体。本文引入了一个配对基准测试，在抽象文本任务和代码构建任务两种情境下，检验LLM智能体在固定预算下是否展现出有意识的工具分配行为。研究者测试了Claude Haiku、Claude Opus、GPT-5.4-mini和GPT-5.6 Sol等前沿模型，发现所有测试模型均表现出有意识的分配行为。该研究为评估智能体的资源利用能力提供了新方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.23332v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Creating a reusable tool is an investment: an agent pays a fixed cost now in exchange for the potential of future reuse. Therefore, a user should prefer an agent that creates a small number of highly reusable tools, rather than many one-offs. We introduce a paired benchmark that tests whether LLM agents exhibit conscious allocation behavior under a fixed budget in two contexts: an abstract text-based formulation and a code-construction task. We find that every frontier model we test---Claude Haiku, Claude Opus, GPT-5.4-mini, and GPT-5.6 Sol--…
items.why_zh: 工具分配能力是LLM智能体实现高效长期任务的关键，该基准为测评和优化这一能力提供了新标准。
items.why_en: Tool allocation is key for efficient long-term LLM agent tasks; this benchmark provides a new standard for evaluating and optimizing it.

items.title_zh: Paris：完全去中心化训练的开源权重扩散模型
items.title_en: Paris: A Decentralized Trained Open-Weight Diffusion Model
items.summary_zh: Paris 是首个完全通过去中心化计算训练并公开发布的扩散模型，证明了无需集中协调的基础设施也能实现高质量的文本到图像生成。该模型已开放研究及商业使用。为了训练它，团队从头实现了分布式扩散训练框架。模型由8个专家扩散模型组成（每个参数规模在129M到605M之间），这些模型在完全隔离的环境下训练，没有梯度、参数或中间激活同步。这一成果展示了去中心化训练在生成模型领域的可行性与潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2510.03434v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present Paris, the first publicly released diffusion model pre-trained entirely through decentralized computation. Paris demonstrates that high-quality text-to-image generation can be achieved without centrally coordinated infrastructure. Paris is open for research and commercial use. Paris required implementing our Distributed Diffusion Training framework from scratch. The model consists of 8 expert diffusion models (129M-605M parameters each) trained in complete isolation with no gradient, parameter, or intermediate activation sync…
items.why_zh: Paris证明了去中心化训练也能产出高质量生成模型，为减少大模型对集中算力的依赖提供了可行路径。
items.why_en: Paris demonstrates that decentralized training can yield high-quality generative models, offering a path to reduce reliance on centralized compute.

items.title_zh: 自变量机器人发布 HOST 框架并开源，让机器人看视频学会新技能
items.title_en: Zibianliang Robot Releases HOST Framework and Open-Sources It, Enabling Robots to Learn New Skills from Videos
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 3 日消息，自变量机器人今日发布 HOST 框架（Human-to-robot One-Shot Skill AcquisiTion，人类到机器人单样本技能获取）并开源，号称“能让机器人仅观察一段数十秒的人类视频就学会新技能，同时保留已掌握的技能。” IT之家从官方介绍获悉，HOST 采用了一种开创性的方法：不去将人类动作翻译为机器人动作并试图模仿，而是让机器人先想象执行动作后的结果，再从结果拆分出需要执行的动作。这种全新方法的效果令人欣喜： 机器人从一段 29 秒人类视频中学习技能的成功率高达 62% ，超越零样本基线 45%。相比 Pi-0.5 + 微调方案，HOST 所需数据量减少 50 倍，学习技能速度提升 500 倍。 HOST 的思路来自认知科学中的“观察学习”理论：人类面对不熟悉的任务时，不需要通过长期练习或者穷举来学习，而是以先验能力在大脑中模拟动作的预期效果，然后执行相应动作。自变量研究人员受此启发，将 HOST 的学习方案从“训练时微调循环”变为“推理时技能获取”， 让机器人通过观察人类执行任务来学习新技能 。 机器人首先要解决的问题是：如何对齐自己执行任务的进度和视频中的进度？ 举例来说：同样工作 10 秒，视频中的人可能已经切完菜、开始炒菜了，机器人还在切菜。如果只仅按时间对齐，机器人就会丢失任务进度。 对此，HOST 的做法是“按任务进度…
items.summary_en: Zibianliang Robot released and open-sourced the HOST framework, enabling robots to learn new skills from a short human video while retaining existing skills. In experiments, it achieved 62% success from a 29-second video, surpassing the zero-shot baseline by 45%, and required 50x less data and was 500x faster than Pi-0.5+fine-tuning.
items.why_zh: HOST大幅降低机器人学习新技能的数据与算力需求，有望加速机器人从实验室走向真实场景。
items.why_en: HOST drastically cuts data and compute requirements for robot skill acquisition, potentially accelerating real-world robot deployment.

items.title_zh: Plymouth Rock推出ChatGPT插件，实时获取房屋保险报价
items.title_en: Plymouth Rock launches ChatGPT plugin for real-time home insurance quotes
items.summary_zh: Plymouth Rock公司推出了一款ChatGPT插件，使用户能够通过该插件实时获取房屋保险报价。这是生成式AI在保险行业中的一个应用案例，旨在简化报价流程、提升效率。目前该插件的具体功能细节和适用范围尚未完全公开，但这一举措显示保险公司正加速拥抱对话式AI技术。对于消费者而言，未来获取保险报价可能更加便捷。
items.summary_en: Plymouth Rock launches ChatGPT plugin for real-time home insurance quotes Insurance Business
items.why_zh: 这是生成式AI在保险业务中的一次落地尝试，可能引领行业用AI重塑客户服务流程。
items.why_en: It is a practical application of generative AI in insurance, potentially reshaping customer service processes.

items.title_zh: OpenAI员工称谷歌早于OpenAI拥有ChatGPT但从未发布
items.title_en: OpenAI employee claims Google had ChatGPT before OpenAI but never released it
items.summary_zh: 据印度今日报道，一位OpenAI员工声称，谷歌曾在OpenAI之前就拥有了类似ChatGPT的模型技术，但从未将其公之于众。这一说法目前未得到谷歌或OpenAI的官方证实。该言论引发了关于AI技术发展时间线和公司战略的讨论，也反映出业内对于技术领先与商业发布之间关系的复杂看法。事件的真实性与后续影响仍待观察。
items.summary_en: OpenAI employee claims Google had ChatGPT before OpenAI but never released it India Today
items.why_zh: 若属实，这一说法将改变人们对AI技术发展时间线的认知，并凸显商业发布时机的战略价值。
items.why_en: If true, it would reshape the perceived AI development timeline and highlight the strategic value of release timing.

items.title_zh: 56.8万亿Token！上周全球大模型调用出炉，国产AI包揽全球调用前五，DeepSeek登顶
items.title_en: 56.8 Trillion Tokens! Weekly Global LLM Usage: Chinese AI Takes Top Five, DeepSeek Leads
items.summary_zh: 56.8万亿Token！上周全球大模型调用出炉，国产AI包揽全球调用前五，DeepSeek登顶 Sohu
items.summary_en: Last week's global LLM usage reached 56.8 trillion tokens, with Chinese AI models taking the top five spots and DeepSeek leading. The data highlights the growing adoption and competitiveness of Chinese large language models.
items.why_zh: 国产大模型包揽全球调用量前五，标志着中国AI模型在应用规模和用户接受度上已处于全球领先位置。
items.why_en: Chinese models dominating global usage top five marks a milestone in their scale and user adoption worldwide.

items.summary_zh: 华为半导体首席科学家廖恒谈芯片“18层宝塔”理论与DeepSeek突破 电脑之家
items.summary_en: Huawei chief semiconductor scientist Liao Heng discussed the '18-layer pagoda' theory for chips and commented on DeepSeek's breakthrough. The remarks connect AI model innovation with semiconductor development, though specific details are limited.
items.why_zh: 华为半导体负责人对DeepSeek的评价，为理解AI创新与芯片需求之间的相互驱动提供了重要线索。
items.why_en: Huawei's semiconductor leader commenting on DeepSeek offers insight into the mutual reinforcement between AI innovation and chip demand.

items.title_zh: 美国或对中国AI模型实施禁令，企业每年或损失120亿美元
items.title_en: Potential US ban on Chinese AI models could cost businesses US$12 billion a year
items.summary_zh: 根据《南华早报》报道，美国可能考虑对中国人工智能模型实施禁令，这一举措预计将使依赖相关技术企业的年损失高达120亿美元。尽管目前尚未公布具体的禁令范围和政策细节，但该数字直观地展现了中国AI模型在美国市场的渗透程度及其商业价值。报道指出，若禁令落地，美国企业可能需要更换AI服务供应商或调整技术方案，从而产生额外成本。这一潜在政策也反映出中美科技竞争在AI领域的进一步升级，其经济影响值得关注。
items.summary_en: Potential US ban on Chinese AI models could cost businesses US$12 billion a year South China Morning Post
items.why_zh: 该报道揭示了美国若限制中国AI模型可能带来的巨大经济损失，凸显AI领域地缘政治风险。
items.why_en: The potential ban underscores the high economic stakes in US-China AI decoupling.

items.title_en: Alibaba Unveils Qwen3.8-MAX AI Model with 2.4 Trillion Parameters

items.summary_en: According to Sohu, Alibaba has released its Qwen3.8-MAX AI model with 2.4 trillion parameters, placing it among the largest models. Detailed performance data and use cases have not been fully disclosed, but the massive scale suggests enhanced capabilities and high compute requirements, strengthening Alibaba's position in the AI race.
items.why_zh: 2.4万亿参数规模代表新一轮大模型竞赛的顶级水平，凸显算力与算法投入。
items.why_en: The 2.4-trillion-parameter scale signifies top-tier competition in large models, highlighting massive investment in compute and algorithms.
